language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hello! My name is Lilly and I am from Peru. I love to travel. Right now, I’m visiting my aunt. She lives near the famous Loch Ness. They say a great monster lives in the lake. It is as big as ten boats. I haven’t seen it. All I’ve seen is the souvenir shop. It is my tradition to always bring something from the places I have visited.

I need to be very careful choosing what to take. My mother said I can take only non-living things. Can you help me distinguish which things are living and which ones are not? My mother wrote me a list of characteristics of all living things. That will definitely help us!
Hello, I am Tim.

Hello! My name is Lilly and I am from Peru. I love to travel. Right now, I’m visiting my aunt. She lives near the famous Loch Ness. They say a great monster lives in the lake. It is as big as ten boats. I haven’t seen it. All I’ve seen is the souvenir shop. It is my tradition to always bring something from the places I have visited.

I need to be very careful choosing what to take. My mother said I can take only non-living things. Can you help me distinguish which things are living and which ones are not? My mother wrote me a list of characteristics of all living things. That will definitely help us!
This souvenir shop has a lot of stuff! I’ve taken a few pictures of some interesting things I have seen. I’m going to read all the characteristics of the living things from my mother's notes.
Then I'll classify the pictures according to her notes. Can you drag the labels to the correct pictures? That will help me classify all the living and non-living things!
